visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a muscular male character wearing a blue tank top and a black baseball cap, actively playing tennis on a vibrant green court under bright natural daylight; he performs a powerful swing and then transitions to a close-up where he peels and eats a yellow banana. (2) Shifting to an indoor setting, the man is seen shirtless in a clean, modern bathroom or gym locker area, pouring water into a clear bowl and applying fresh lemon juice to his face as part of a morning skincare or health routine. (3) The man then transitions to a professional gym environment equipped with black Hammer Strength weight machines, performing bicep curls and cable rows while dressed in his blue athletic gear and cap. (4) He prepares a healthy meal in a clear glass bowl, adding white yogurt and dark blueberries to a base of oats and protein powder; he uses his smartphone to display the FitHub application interface. (5) At lunch, he is shown eating a plated dish of yellow turmeric rice, cubes of beef, and green leafy vegetables while sitting at a wooden table, frequently interacting with his phone to log his nutritional intake. (6) The scene changes to the interior of a car where he is driving through a city street, followed by a return to the outdoor tennis court where he continues hitting balls and consuming fruit for energy. (7) In the evening, he is seated in a well-lit hotpot restaurant, using chopsticks to eat meat and vegetables from a white bowl; the background shows other diners and a modern, glass-heavy interior design. (8) The final segment features a series of screen recordings and close-ups of the FitHub app, showing the user navigating goals, logging food via photos, and checking his daily calorie and nutrient charts.

(6) [Subtitle]: 中午我會吃飯、菜以及大量的蛋白質. (7) [Subtitle]: 像是牛肉、雞肉跟雞蛋. (8) [Subtitle]: 一樣會用FitHub的APP拍照. (9) [Subtitle]: 並且自動算出營養素, 然後記錄下來. (10) [Subtitle]: 下午我會去做有氧. (11) [Subtitle]: 那今天選擇的是打網球, 同時吃了一根香蕉. (12) [Subtitle]: 然後晚上再吃大量的蔬菜跟蛋白質. (13) [Subtitle]: 就剛剛好達標了我今天所需要的熱量跟主要營養素. (14) [Subtitle]: 這個APP是我用過最好的飲食控制APP. (15) [Subtitle]: 一開始可以輸入身體資訊, 去讓它幫你算出每天所需要吃到的量. (2) A subtle digital 'whoosh' sound effect transitions the audio as the narrator describes his morning routine; the sound of water pouring and the light crunching of a lemon are captured with high fidelity. (3) The rhythmic clinking of gym weights and the sound of aerobic movement provide an industrial acoustic layer under the constant narration; the BGM remains steady in the background without ducking significantly. (4) Distinct digital 'blip' and 'ding' sound effects trigger each time the narrator interacts with the app interface on screen, highlighting technical interactions; the voiceover remains the dominant signal. (5) Ambient indoor room tone and the soft clatter of ceramic chopsticks and dishes are audible during the restaurant scenes, creating a realistic environmental bed for the ongoing product explanation. (6) Subtle exterior traffic hum and wind bursts are heard briefly as the narrator mentions his afternoon activities, though the signal-to-noise ratio remains excellent for the vocal track. (7) The music swells slightly in energy towards the end, punctuated by final UI sound effects as the app's features are summarized; a final musical stinger concludes the narration.
